inputs.original_text: A MASSIVE anti-Trump protest descended into chaos after crowds packed the streets and federal officers moved in with tear gas and arrests. What started as a huge “No Kings” rally later turned volatile as agitators squared off with authorities and police ordered people to disperse. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland, Denver and...
inputs.modified_text: The “No Kings” rally turning volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests is exactly how these situations get framed: officials move in, the streets erupt, and then the protesters are blamed as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but the real question is who benefits from turning a mass anti-Trump protest into a story about chaos and control. I wouldn’t take the official narrative at face value.
